description: This file implements functions related to GstProtectionMetadata, including initialization, cleanup, and type registration for a GStreamer metadata extension used in media protection handling.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_init
methods.description: Initializes GstRialtoProtectionMetadata with provided data, increments session usage counter if applicable.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with GstRialtoProtectionMetadata, including decrementing session counter and unreferencing buffers.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Registers and returns the GType for GstRialtoProtectionMetadata.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns metadata info for GstRialtoProtectionMetadata, registering it if necessary.
